snippet.title: Dohyo Dreams Rise to Yokozuna Demo Wishlist Trailer
snippet.description:
Rise from rookie rikishi to Yokozuna in this sumo narrative RPG.

Forge bonds with your stablemates. Master card-based sumo combat. 
Live the life of Ishizuna-beya.

Demo coming to Steam Next Fest.

🔗 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4061390/Dohyo_Dreams_Rise_to_Yokozuna/
🔗 Game Jolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/dohyo-dreams/1057834
